results.title: The Light
results.overview: A portrait of a modern family between collapse and new beginnings dealing with the big issues of our times, in a world that is reeling. Tim, Milena, their almost grown-up twins Frieda and Jon and their illegitimate son Dio - this is the Engels family, who seemingly have nothing left to hold them together when housekeeper Farrah enters their lives. The mysterious Syrian woman puts the Engels' emotional world to an unexpectedly wild test.

results.title: F+
results.overview: A group of young teenagers plan the perfect heist by breaking into their middle school to change their failing test grades.

results.title: ONE SHOT with Ed Sheeran
results.overview: One singer. One city. One shot. Ed Sheeran rocks the streets of New York with his greatest hits in this groundbreaking, real-time music experience.

results.title: Blister
results.overview: Amidst a chaotic July 4th party, a momentary oversight sends a young mother scrambling to protect her baby.

results.title: Recife Assombrado 2 - A Maldição De Branca Dias
results.original_title: Recife Assombrado 2 - A Maldição De Branca Dias
results.overview: In Recife, a group of young researchers specializing in paranormal phenomena is hired by an enigmatic businessman to find the legendary treasure of Branca Dias. As they delve into the city's rich history in search of clues about the mysterious artifact, they find themselves entangled in a web of frightening secrets hidden in the capital of Pernambuco, putting their lives at risk as they try to unravel the hauntings that surround them.

results.title: What We Can Know About Edmond and Basile
results.original_title: What We Can Know About Edmond and Basile
results.overview: An exploration of Edmond Dédé and Basile Barès were 19th-century New Orleans composers of color. Dédé, born free, was an orchestral composer and violist, known for his opera Morgiane. Barès, born into slavery, was a pianist and composer of music for dance halls, unique for being the only known American composer with a copyright assigned to his work while enslaved.

results.title: Pita Hall
results.overview: Kalender runs a small restaurant, inherited from his father. Ten years ago, after the death of his wife, he became increasingly withdrawn. He's averse to innovation and averse to taking risks, and his shop is struggling. The recent opening of a new-generation restaurant, Pidburger, only makes things worse. However, with the arrival of Öcü, a transformation begins, and they embark on numerous adventures to save the shop.

results.title: Love, Imagined
results.overview: Youssef, an introverted university professor, tries to live a quiet and secluded life, but the arrival of the student Warda into his world turns everything upside down. while she is trying to mend her relationship with her boyfriend, Noah, Youssef finds himself gradually becoming entangled in their relationship.  As illusions intertwine with reality at the heart of a complicated love triangle, feelings he thought had long faded awaken within him.

results.title: A Microphone in the Head
results.overview: Joonas is dead. But through a haunted karaoke mic, he asks his heartbroken fiancée to take him to his mother… so he can finally come out to her – a secret the fiancée never saw coming.

results.title: Larga Noche
results.overview: Rosario, an octogenarian woman, lives with her son Antonio in a tense relationship. After an argument on the eve of San Juan, Antonio leaves home. When midnight arrives and Antonio does not return, Rosario, driven by guilt, decides to embark on a journey in search of him that will completely change her reality.

results.title: It's Never Over, Jeff Buckley
results.overview: Rising musician Jeff Buckley had only released one album when he died suddenly in 1997. Now, never-before-seen footage, exclusive voice messages, and accounts from those closest to him offer a portrait of the captivating singer.

results.title: No Choice
results.overview: A young woman becomes unexpectedly pregnant and starts having harrowing, prophetic dreams that she will die if she can't get an abortion.

results.title: Quando Elas Se Movimentam
results.overview: Inspired by the phrase of the American activist Angela Davis – “When the black woman moves, the whole structure of society moves with her” -, the documentary tells the story of three black women whose personal trajectories are intertwined with laws that transformed their lives and those of countless Brazilian citizens.

results.title: Granted
results.overview: A girlfriend breaks up with her boyfriend, only for a vampire to try to seduce her and kill her boyfriend.

results.title: Redress
results.overview: A few hours before his third Michelin star is awarded, a renowned chef disappears with his sous chef during a hunting trip. His daughter Clara finds herself alone at the head of the restaurant, harassed by paparazzi. Two years later, she receives an invitation to a famous gastronomic congress in Taiwan.

results.title: Balkanika: Dark Side
results.overview: A drug smuggling crew from Bosnia-Herzegovina faces chaos when a Syrian migrant's explosives attract ISIS terrorists into the country, forcing them into a deadly game of loyalty and survival on the Bosnia and Herzegovina-Croatia border.

results.title: Castration Movie Anthology ii. The Best of Both Worlds
results.original_title: Castration Movie Anthology ii. The Best of Both Worlds
results.overview: In New York, Circle tries to leave a trans separatist cult.

results.title: Sunray: Fallen Soldier
results.overview: Forced to confront the death of his daughter following a fatal encounter with drugs, ex-military soldier Andy becomes hell-bent on finding those responsible. With nothing to lose, a violent criminal underworld unravels in his wake.

results.title: Throne of Seal The Movie: The Crownless God
results.original_title: 神印王座剧场版：伊莱克斯传奇
results.overview: The legendary epic of Elekes, re - presenting the glorious path of the great Necromancer of the Undead Scourge, Elekes.
